parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. The maximum value of PageSize is 100. The default number of entries per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The AccessKey ID that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
> You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: StartTs
parameters.description: The discovery time of the leaked information that you want to query. All AccessKey leak information discovered after this point in time is returned. This parameter is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The processing status of the leaked AccessKey information that you want to query. Valid values:
- **pending**: unprocessed
- **dealed**: processed.
